edition: 2024 core rules, verified against official SRD 5.2.1; 2025 Eberron: Forge of the Artificer for Artificer, with explicit secondary-source verification limit.
assumptions: Standard array 15/14/13/12/10/8, background boosts only; no species ability-score bonuses.
Maximum class Hit Die at level 1; fixed average at level 2; all begin with full resources.
All twelve core subclasses begin at level 3; none are granted here.
Origin feats and species magic are included separately from class spell counts.
Class package A plus background package A; no adventure treasure assumed. Duplicate items remain in inventory; duplicate proficiencies counted once.
Default proficiency bonus +2. Saves field lists proficient saves only; other saves equal the relevant ability modifier.
Backgrounds use the four freely verified SRD options. Human bonus feat is Alert; all Humans also receive Heroic Inspiration after Long Rest.
Choose size Medium except Halfling/Gnome Small. Elf characters have Darkvision60ft, Fey Ancestry and Trance; their selected Keen Senses proficiency is included.
